welcomeDescription: Answer a few questions so we can recommend the perfect training plan for you.
pathTitle: How do you want to start?
pathAIDescription: Get a personalized program based on your goals
pathTemplateDescription: Pick a proven program and make it yours
pathBlankDescription: Build your own program exercise by exercise
agentBuildHint: Use Claude or another AI agent to build your program →
changeProgramDescription: Pick a new training plan — your workout history stays intact.
questionnaireErrorBody: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
questionnaireErrorDisplayNameTakenTitle: We couldn't set up your profile
questionnaireErrorDisplayNameTakenBody: An account with a similar name already exists. Try again, and if it keeps failing you can change your display name later from your Account page.
errorAuthExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
errorGenericProgram: We couldn't create your program. Try again in a moment.

embeddedAgent.title: Build your program with the assistant
embeddedAgent.placeholderBody: Tell me about your training, injuries, or schedule. I'll help shape a program that fits.
embeddedAgent.quotaBody: You've reached the conversation limit for this hour. Take a short break and come back to keep building.
embeddedAgent.errorBody: We couldn't reach the assistant. Try again in a moment.
embeddedAgent.threadErrorBody: Something failed on our side. Try again — your draft is safe.
embeddedAgent.offlineBody: Reconnect to keep building your program. We'll pick up right where you left off.
embeddedAgent.restartConfirmBody: Your current draft will be discarded. This can't be undone.
embeddedAgent.generatingStatus: Reading your answers · drafting · validating · preparing preview
embeddedAgent.draftQuotaBody: You've already used your 3 drafts for today. Come back tomorrow to try a fresh angle.
embeddedAgent.programQuotaBody: You've hit the monthly cap on AI-generated programs. Use one of your existing programs or wait until next month.
embeddedAgent.disclosureBody: Your answers are stored on our servers and sent to Google Gemini to draft a program. Raw chat content is purged 90 days after you commit or abandon. We do not scrub your messages — avoid sharing anything sensitive that isn't about training.

embeddedAgentPreview.title: Your draft program
embeddedAgentPreview.subtitle: Review the plan, then activate it or keep iterating in chat.
embeddedAgentPreview.missingPreview: We couldn't load your draft preview. Go back to chat and try again.
embeddedAgentPreview.argsFallbackHint: Detailed prescriptions will appear in the next refresh — UUID list shown for now.
embeddedAgentPreview.commitErrorBody: Something failed on our side. Your draft is still here — try again in a moment.
embeddedAgentPreview.stuckBody: After a couple of failed attempts the AI flow may not be the right fit right now. Pick a proven template or start with an empty program — your answers are saved.
embeddedAgentPreview.noActiveThreadBody: Your draft session ended. Start a fresh conversation to build a new program.
